name: Malayan Banking Berhad
overview: 今年 Maybank 完成收购 Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad 剩余 30.95% 股权，将该公司完全纳入集团，保险与 Takaful 板块的持股结构发生变化。其他公告主要涉及股息再投资计划的新股发行及常规企业事务，未见其他业务板块有扩张、缩减或退出。
overview_en: During the year, Maybank completed the acquisition of the remaining 30.95% equity interest in Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad, bringing the company fully into the group and changing the ownership structure of the Insurance and Takaful segment. Other announcements mainly related to new share issuances under the dividend reinvestment plan and routine corporate matters, with no expansion, reduction or exit observed in other business segments.

segments.name: 集团保险与Takaful
segments.note: 今年完成收购 Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad 剩余 30.95% 股权，使该公司成为集团全资子公司。
segments.note_en: Completed the acquisition of the remaining 30.95% equity interest in Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad this year, making it a wholly-owned subsidiary of the group.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 完成收购 Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad 剩余 30.95% 股权，现金代价 4.83 亿令吉。
actions.text_en: Completed the acquisition of the remaining 30.95% equity interest in Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad for a cash consideration of RM4.83 billion.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 并已获得国行批准及签署无条件买卖协议。
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisition of the remaining 30.95% equity interest in Maybank Ageas Holdings Berhad for a cash consideration of RM4.83 billion, with BNM approval obtained and an unconditional share purchase agreement signed.
